City of Montrose Ballot Questions
Ballot Question 2A - Elections
Shall Article I and III of the Charter of the City of Montrose, Colorado be amended to move the general municipal election from April of even-numbered years to November of even-numbered years?

City of Montrose Ballot Questions
Ballot Question 2B - Term Limits
Shall Article I and III of the Charter of the City of Montrose, Colorado be amended to restrict council members to serve eight years of elected service in that person's lifetime with such eight years occurring through any combination of consecutive or nonconsecutive terms of office, and shall this requirement apply to any candidate after November 3, 2026?

City of Montrose Ballot Questions
Ballot Question 2C - Police Chief
Shall Article VIII of the Charter of the City of Montrose, Colorado be amended to allow City Council the right to approve or disapprove the City Manager's decision to appoint and discharge the Police Chief of the Montrose Police Department?

City of Montrose Ballot Questions
Ballot Question 2D - City Clerk
Shall Article VIII of the Charter of the City of Montrose, Colorado be amended to allow City Council the right to approve or disapprove of the City Manager's decision to appoint and discharge the City Clerk?

West End Health Service District Ballot Question 6A
Shall West End Health Service District be organized?

West End Health Service District Ballot Issue 6B
SHALL WEST END HEALTH SERVICE DISTRICT TAXES BE INCREASED $949,950.00 ANNUALLY BEGINNING IN COLLECTION YEAR 2027, AND BY SUCH AMOUNTS AS MAY BE GENERATED THEREAFTER BY LEVYING AN AD VALOREM PROPERTY TAX NOT TO EXCEED 20.000 MILLS, TO PAY DISTRICT OPERATING AND CAPITAL EXPENSES, PROVIDED THAT SUCH MILL LEVY RATE MAY BE ADJUSTED TO OFFSET REVENUE LOSSES RESULTING FROM REFUNDS, ABATEMENTS AND CHANGES IN THE LAW OR THE METHOD FOR CALCULATING ASSESSED VALUATION; AND SHALL SUCH REVENUES AND ALL OTHER DISTRICT REVENUES BE COLLECTED, RETAINED AND SPENT AS A VOTER-APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE, OFFSET AND EXCEPTION TO THE LIMITS WHICH WOULD OTHERWISE APPLY UNDER TABOR (ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION) OR ANY OTHER LAW?
